const [blocks, pauses, recurringBlocks, flagsRow, specialDayRows] = await Promise.all([...])
const skippedMealLogs = await db.select()...  // sequential after
const workVirtuals    = await expandWorkBlocks(...)  // depends on pauses — ok to be sequential
const pauseRows       = await db.select()...  // sequential after

// FIX — include skippedMealLogs + supplementPauses in the first Promise.all (6 → 7 concurrent)
const [blocks, pauses, recurringBlocks, flagsRow, specialDayRows, skippedMealLogs, pauseRows] =
  await Promise.all([
    db.select().from(timeBlocks)...,
    db.select().from(modulePauses)...,
    db.select().from(timeBlocks).where(and(...isNotNull(timeBlocks.recurrenceRule))),
    db.select().from(goalSettings)...,
    db.select().from(specialDays)...,
    db.select({ logDate:..., mealId:... }).from(dailyNutritionLogs)...,  // moved here
